\section[samayaṁ]{\ml{സമയം} (samayaṁ) — time}

\label{lesson:ML-C139-time}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a tiger, then the Malayalam for a rabbit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{സമയം}}
\textbf{\ml{സമയം}} (\emph{samayaṁ}) — \textquotedblleft{}time\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\ml{സമയം} \ml{എത്ര}?} — \textquotedblleft{}what time is it?\textquotedblright{}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The question on every street.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{samayaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{samayaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} ask \emph{samayaṁ etra?}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a tiger, then the Malayalam for a rabbit, then say \emph{samayaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{സമയം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Time\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[miniṟṟŭ]{\ml{മിനിറ്റ്} (miniṟṟŭ) — a minute}

\label{lesson:ML-C139-minute}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a rabbit, then the Malayalam for time.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മിനിറ്റ്}}
\textbf{\ml{മിനിറ്റ്}} (\emph{miniṟṟŭ}) — \textquotedblleft{}a minute\textquotedblright{}, from English. \textbf{\ml{ഒരു} \ml{മിനിറ്റ്}} — \textquotedblleft{}one minute\textquotedblright{}, said with a raised hand.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The polite way to ask for a moment.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{miniṟṟŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{miniṟṟŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{oru miniṟṟŭ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a rabbit, then the Malayalam for time, then say \emph{miniṟṟŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മിനിറ്റ്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A minute\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[maṇikkūr]{\ml{മണിക്കൂർ} (maṇikkūr) — an hour}

\label{lesson:ML-C139-hour}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for time, then the Malayalam for a minute.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മണിക്കൂർ}}
\textbf{\ml{മണിക്കൂർ}} (\emph{maṇikkūr}) — \textquotedblleft{}an hour\textquotedblright{}. It begins with \textbf{\ml{മണി}}, the word in \textbf{\ml{ഒരു} \ml{മണി}}, \textquotedblleft{}one o'clock\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Sixty minutes.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{maṇikkūr}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{oru maṇikkūr}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for time, then the Malayalam for a minute, then say \emph{maṇikkūr} again
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മാസം}}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The frame for the months you know.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māsaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{oru māsaṁ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a minute, then the Malayalam for an hour, then say \emph{māsaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മാസം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A month\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[varṣaṁ]{\ml{വർഷം} (varṣaṁ) — a year}

\label{lesson:ML-C139-year}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for an hour, then the Malayalam for a month.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{വർഷം}}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The biggest frame.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{varṣaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{oru varṣaṁ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for an hour, then the Malayalam for a month, then say \emph{varṣaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
